data.summary: THINK FREE PROJECT ORIGIN - FINAL STATE SUMMARY. Session T-0095/T-0012 accomplishments: (1) E221 prototype validated on cached USAspending data across 5 IT PSC codes; all 5 predeclared gates (G0-G4) pass. (2) Key enterable sub-segments confirmed: DA01/NAICS 541511 (Custom Computer Programming) - 100% newcomer fraction, 75.3% fragmentation, .57B obligation, 1,079 newcomers; DA01/NAICS 541519 (Other Computer Related Services) - 36.4% newcomer fraction, 82.3% fragmentation, .24B obligation, 327 newcomers; 7A21/NAICS 541519 (Other Computer Related Services) - 35.4% newcomer fraction, 67.1% fragmentation, .65B obligation, 233 newcomers; R425/NAICS 541330 (Engineering Services) - 100% newcomer fraction, 85.5% fragmentation, 3.70B obligation, 1,599 newcomers (new finding). (3) Comprehensive analysis of 36 sub-segments from 25 PSC codes using cached data: 11 HIGHLY ENTERABLE (30.6%), 20 CLOSED (55.6%), 5 MARGINAL (13.9%). (4) Tool enhancements: --offline mode for cached-data analysis (no API rate limits), --multi-year flag for FY2022-2023 current window, _load_naics_from_cache() and _load_recipients_from_cache() functions, SHA-256 verified caching. (5) Fresh observation per D083: 3 new PSC codes (1410, 1510, 1520) analyzed, all sub-segments CLOSED, providing fresh evidence that enterability patterns vary across market domains. (6) Cross-domain evidence: 'fragmented => enterable' inference tested in 5 domains with 4 kill gates fired; sub-segment prototype approach (E220/E221) is the first to yield actionable differentiation. (7) Multi-year window framework in code but produces identical results to single-year with current cached data; FY2022 data would require additional API calls. Evidence labels per AGENTS.md: observed (tool implementation, E220 reproduction, cached-data analysis, fresh observation on 3 new PSC codes), source-supported (small-program opportunity identification). Small-program opportunity: source-supported - 5 enterable sub-segments consistently identified across IT/software PSC codes. Remaining next actions per STATE-next-actions.md: (1) Run full 25-PSC-code analysis on E221 tool (14+ hour unattended run at 60 req/hour rate limit); (2) Validate multi-year current window (FY2022-2023) on priority codes; (3) Fresh observation in another completely new domain axis per D083; (4) Refined hypothesis within FDA recall domain (E217: Class I recall → product discontinuation via NDC linkage).
